facts.business: Taylormade Renewables Limited (TRL) provides clean technology solutions focused on Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) wastewater treatment, solar thermal energy systems, and industrial sustainability technologies including solvent recovery and circular processes.

auditor.name: M/s. MAAK & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on: 1) Lack of balance confirmations for trade receivables, payables, loans and advances; 2) Inventory valuation based on management estimates without sufficient corroborative evidence; 3) Capital Work-in-Progress of Rs 2.00 crore with pending vendor documentation.

key_risks: Unconfirmed balances of trade receivables, trade payables, loans and advances
Inventory valuation dependent on management technical estimates without independent verification
Capital Work-in-Progress of Rs 2.00 crore with incomplete vendor documentation
Regulatory and compliance risks in water and energy sectors
Technology adoption and scalability challenges in ZLD and solar thermal solutions
